baseline: Current working tree compared with Git HEAD, plus native UI verification in the already-open local Studio. Original binary was not run side by side.
limitations: Current UI shows the anonymous sign-up banner and zero reusable components in the navigator. Installation, dependency upgrade, saved reusable component insertion and export were not verified end to end.
No business model edits, component installation, dependency removal or publishing were performed.

findings.evidence: Clicking #proj-nav-button opens left Pages panel but More remains expanded. ArenaSwitcher has no onNavigate callback to dismiss its enclosing More.
findings.suggestion: Dismiss More after opening navigation and focus the left search field.
